The existing verified transfer module is imported under a non-main name, its DATASET global is set only to the explicit receipt label MSVR_head16_pair, and only command/prior/CAPTURES are reused. Its dataset-specific main is never called. Each attempted transfer writes a pre-call receipt and captures stdout/stderr/actual return code, with timeout300 and check_returncode; no catch, retry or fallback was added. The controller exposes raw,best,states_raw for each of the two variants; export requires exactly six distinct entries, verifies each resolved path lies inside the MS run root, and checks recorded path/size/SHA against actual bytes. Before local transfers, D free space must exceed all six binaries plus100MB and C space must exceed all extracted text plus compressed text package plus100MB. Only text is staged on C; all six binaries transfer directly to fresh D paths and are immediately size/SHA checked. The package has exact manifest members and extraction targets are contained in the fresh selected local root.

Retirement occurs only after all local text and six D archives verify. It rechecks the remote package and all six remote binaries, removes only the identified remote text package, then removes only its local text package. No best/raw/state cleanup exists. The proof retains all transport receipts and marks fresh independent result audit pending; unique evidence and teacher/K201 artifacts are untouched.
